name: Melt-Eye
doc: Melt-Eye (the Hexadragon's enemy attack): the root and the director - fifteen beams leaving the caster's eyes on curved paths toward the targets' centre, each with a shrinking ring at its start, a trail of sprites running along its path and a splash and a spinning splash model where it lands; drops flying off two eyes; the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag158_melt_eye.cpp) run on the program's memory (its beam records, drop and spark tables, queues and packet arenas in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The timeline: one beam a tick from tick 1, the drops at the two eyes, the sound; the damage

parts.title: Beams
parts.doc: Each beam's path from one of the caster's eyes to near the targets' centre (a curve lifted at random) and when its ring, trail and splash start (draws nothing itself)

parts.title: Ring
parts.doc: A shrinking ring model at the beam's start, turned along its path, fading at its end

parts.title: Trail
parts.doc: Sprites running along the beam's path, the head slowing, sparks left behind

parts.title: Splash
parts.doc: A splash sprite where the beam lands and a spinning splash model growing, fading

parts.title: Drops
parts.doc: Drops flying off the caster's two eyes, shrinking, slowing
